summary.en: Lawyers are striking against the suspension of provincial health commission powers while armed clashes continue, including three deaths in a Noshki firing and nine BLA terrorists killed in a precision strike in Balochistan. A shooting over a TikTok dispute left two people dead, and a drone dropped pistols, cartridges and heroin near the Punjab border. Iran is seeking to contain the war between Pakistan and the Taliban, and the repatriation of illegal Afghan nationals is slowing in Khyber. The conflict still accounts for 1,794 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Advokater streiker mot suspensjon av provinsielle helsekommisjoners myndighet mens væpnede sammenstøt fortsetter, inkludert tre døde i en skyting i Noshki og ni BLA-terrorister drept i et presisjonsangrep i Balochistan. En skyting over en TikTok-konflikt etterlot to personer døde, og en drone slapp pistoler, patroner og heroin nær grensen til Punjab. Iran forsøker å dempe krigen mellom Pakistan og Taliban, og tilbakeføringen av ulovlige afghanske statsborgere går saktere i Khyber. Konflikten står fortsatt for 1 794 dødsfall knyttet til kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Insurgency in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa
background.extract: Since 2004, an insurgency has been fought in the Pakistani province of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa by Islamist militant groups such as the Tehrik-i-Taliban Pakistan (TTP), Jundallah, Lashkar-e-Islam (LeI), the Tehreek-e-Nafaz-e-Shariat-e-Mohammadi (TNSM), Al-Qaeda, and their Central Asian allies such as the Islamic State – Khorasan Province (ISKP), Islamic Movement of Uzbekistan, East Turkistan Movement, Jamaat-ul-Ahrar, Ittihad-ul-Mujahideen Pakistan, and elements of organised crime. Before being transformed into an insurgency in 2017, the conflict was a war.
